entries.title: Generative AI and enterprise software: What's the revenue uplift potential?
entries.quote: we predict that the revenue uplift for enterprise software companies (in addition to the cloud providers of gen AI processing capacity) will be approaching a US$10 billion run rate by the end of 2024.
entries.metric: gen AI revenue uplift run rate for enterprise software
entries.subject: Generative AI in enterprise software

entries.title: Gen AI chip demand fans a semi tailwind…for now
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that the market for specialized chips optimized for generative AI will be valued at over US$50 billion in 2024, up from close to nothing in 2022.
entries.subject: AI chips

entries.title: Taking control: Generative AI trains on private, enterprise data
entries.quote: In 2024, Deloitte predicts that enterprise spending on generative AI will grow by 30%.
entries.metric: growth in enterprise gen AI spending
entries.subject: Enterprise generative AI

entries.title: Walking the tightrope: As generative AI meets EU regulation, pragmatism is likely
entries.quote: The European Union is expected to set the stage for global regulation of generative AI in 2024, influencing its own markets and serving as a template for other regions.
entries.subject: AI regulation

entries.title: A raw deal: Will materials shortages, supply chain challenges threaten tech's future?
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that multiple regions will run short of gallium and possibly germanium in 2024 and may start seeing shortages of rare earth elements (REEs) by 2025.
entries.subject: Critical raw materials

entries.title: Semiconductor sustainability: Chips take a smaller byte out of resources
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts year-over-year declines in average water intensity and energy intensity, as well as continued shift in renewable energy mix, across all leading chipmakers.
entries.subject: Semiconductor sustainability

entries.title: Dialing down the carbon: Telco sustainability surges on the back of four new trends
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that telcos worldwide will be able to reduce their carbon footprint by 2%, or 12 million tons of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) in 2024 and do the same again in 2025.
entries.subject: Telecom sustainability

entries.title: Regulations take effect: ESG reporting software sales are expected to soar in 2024
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts the tipping point will be reached in 2024, with growth accelerating to over 30% and revenues climbing from under an estimated US$800 million in 2023 to just over US$1 billion in 2024.
entries.subject: ESG reporting software

entries.title: On solid ground: AgTech is driving sustainable farming and is expected to harvest US$18 billion in 2024 revenues
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts the agricultural technology revenue opportunity ... will be US$18 billion globally in 2024, with a 19% CAGR between 2020 and 2024.
entries.subject: Agricultural technology

entries.title: Women's elite sports: Breaking the billion-dollar barrier
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2024, revenue generated by women's elite sports will surpass US$1 billion for the first time, with US$1.28 billion in total forecast revenues
entries.subject: Women's sports

entries.title: Driven to tiers: Streaming video services look to up their profitability game with viewers
entries.quote: In 2024, Deloitte predicts that the combined number of subscription video on demand tiers offered by the top US providers will more than double between 2022 and 2024: from an average of four options to eight.
entries.metric: average SVOD tiers offered by top US providers
entries.subject: Streaming video pricing tiers

entries.title: Cinematic and interactive universes: Games and studios come together to bring the biggest stories to life
entries.quote: Hollywood is looking to games for new IP that they can expand and monetize, and game companies are eyeing TV and film collaborations to help make their IP work harder and offset soaring game development costs.
entries.subject: Games and film IP crossover
entries.note: The chapter states no numeric prediction; the quote is its trend statement.

entries.title: Shuffle, subscribe, stream: Consumer audio market is expected to amass listeners in 2024, but revenues could remain modest
entries.quote: We also predict that the global audio entertainment market will surpass US$75 billion in revenue in 2024, up 7% across these four formats.
entries.subject: Audio entertainment

entries.title: Will endless low cost content do to gaming what it did to TV and film?
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that these platforms will pay out almost US$1.5 billion to their content developers in 2024, and the number of paid independent developers on 3D UGC gaming platforms will exceed 10 million.
entries.metric: 3D UGC gaming platform payouts to creators
entries.subject: User-generated game content

entries.title: Smartphone authentication: The killer app that can augment the smartphone's utility
entries.quote: Smartphones may be used trillions of times in 2024 to authenticate across an ever-widening range of actions
entries.subject: Smartphone authentication

entries.title: Signals from space: Direct-to-device satellite phone connectivity boosts coverage
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that over 200 million smartphones that can connect with satellite services will be sold in 2024.
entries.subject: Direct-to-device satellite connectivity

entries.title: No bump to bitrates for digital apps in the near term: Is a period of enough fixed broadband connectivity approaching?
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that, in 2024, over 90% of the most used online applications on fixed broadband networks in developed markets will have the same vendor-recommended bitrate as in 2023.
entries.metric: share of top apps with unchanged recommended bitrate
entries.subject: Broadband speed demand

entries.title: Keeping it local: Cloud sovereignty a major focus of the future
entries.quote: government cloud ... is forecast to surpass US$41 billion in 2024, up 16% over 2023.
entries.subject: Sovereign and government cloud

entries.title: Life after debt: Venture debt funding could grow again in 2024
entries.quote: In 2024, US tech venture debt could rise to US$14–16 billion, up 25% from 2023 levels.
entries.subject: Tech venture debt

notes: 23rd edition by count from 2002. Deloitte states 19 topics in four categories (section field); 19 captured. The Deloitte Insights edition URL serves the full report PDF. Published late November 2023 (introduction cites a source accessed 16 November 2023); exact day not confirmed. Rank is the order in the report.
